about: #6203 measure-validity: 10 panel pages per #6388 stratum (sorted by stored CER, positions 0,3,6,9,13,16,19,23,26,29), scored by a blind Opus subagent reading the image. Not a human read.

latin-print.note: An omitted citation line: 'Exstat inter veteres scriptores Ed-' drops 'mundi Martene. to.1.par.2.pag.124.'. Also 'Confœderatio' is read as 'Fœderatio' and 'cxlv' as 'exlv', plus small name slips ('Ludewaldum' for Luderwaldum, 'EINSIDELIS' for EINSIEDELS, 'ILDEFONSUS' for ILDEPHONSUS).
Essentially exact. The whole page matches, and the catchword 'ribus' is correctly merged into 'auribus'.
Faithful. Minor slips: 'præmerentur' for 'premerentur', the paragraph number 'II.' dropped, and long-s rendered as 'f' in 'condemnaffe' and 'vocaffe'.
The printed body is accurate, with abbreviations kept diplomatically. The handwritten marginalia are approximate guesses (e.g. 'Legio bono institura', 'rot. cur') and their placement is loose.
Body and verse are exact. The footnotes are expanded and normalised rather than transcribed ('Instit. Or. l. 8. c. 3.' becomes 'Institutio Oratoria liber 8. caput 3.', '&c.' becomes 'et cetera').
Accurate. The paragraphs are re-broken at the marginal numbers 9–14, and 'vid.' is expanded to 'videlicet'; no real text errors.

The main column is near-exact (only 'vlque' for 'vsque'), but the transcription adds a 'second column' of letter fragments ('ri, fie, N, nu, in, rú…') from the edge of the facing leaf. That is text from another page, not this one.
Clean. The one word error is 'ruat necesse est' where the print has 'necessum est'.
Faithful, keeping even the printer's 'in in gemio'. Small slips: 'eiusinodi' for 'eiusmodi', 'quouisq;' for 'quousq;', 'fono' for 'sono', and 'supra eu' with the macron of 'eū' lost.
Accurate except the authority's name: 'Excellentissimi Ballzi' where the print has 'Barlæi'. It also adds italics to names that are roman in the print, which is formatting only.

zh-manuscript.note: All 8 columns match the leaf character for character (擊柝之吏位卑祿薄… through 職易稱也); only the running header/folio (欽定四庫全書, 西山讀書記, 十八) is not transcribed.
All 8 columns match (勿為氣稟物欲所阻撓… 服膺勿失則非賢不); header 欽定四庫全書/松陽講義/卷二/二十二 correct.
Exact except col 4 '丈八年秦伐晉取武' where the leaf has 文八年 (Duke Wen's reign) — a dated reference corrupted by one stroke.

Diagram page of eight FIVE-line figures (rightmost all solid) under a blank ruled grid, but stored text renders them as eight 6-line hexagrams ䷀䷹䷝䷲䷸䷜䷳䷁ ('Eight Pure Hexagrams', incl. an all-broken 坤 not on the leaf) and invents a margin '金氏易說' where the leaf reads 欽定四庫全書 / 卷十五.

Dictionary page in mixed large/small script: every 丨 ditto mark for the headword is dropped (e.g. '淮南子人衆則狼衆則食人' for 人衆則丨狼衆則食人, i.e. 'men many eat wolves'), the clause 狼丨丨則不能動 after '常駕於' is omitted, and the footer reads '御定謂府拾遺' for 御定韻府拾遺; headwords and fanqie otherwise correct.
All 8 columns match (為朔是造歴先天時也… 以至於昏迷), including 此盖嗣侯舉先王之誅以繩羲和.
Page has only 2 text columns (rest blank ruled); 自為謀則不忠是厚於先王而自薄也何罪於先王遂 / 不徙 is exact.

Collation notes match exactly (考異一本序祭仲諫而公弗聽諫上有驟字…); the one deviation is final '諸兄公族' where the leaf plainly writes 諸凡公族 (stored gives the intended Mao reading, so it silently emends rather than misreads).
Body (人之誠偽也行猶治也… 社以上公配祭) is exact; only the appended margin title reads '畫記大全' where the leaf has 禮記大全.
All 8 columns match incl. the elevated 太祖孝陵設神宮監 column and 者俱謁陵出城者詣辭; 員 for 貟 is variant normalisation.

english-print.note: All 14 oracle answers match the leaf word for word ("proportionable age", "syrups, &c."); the marginal "Signs." label is dropped and the sign column is moved into an image-desc, which is harmless.

The layout is right, but some numbers are wrong: row 25 reads "17. 7,9 ... 17.13,8" where the leaf has 18 throughout (15 cells), row 4 cols 34"-36" read "2.54,4/2.54,5/2.54,6" where the leaf has 2.54,3/2.54,3/2.54,4, and rows 5, 6 and 9 each have one wrong digit ("3.37,9" for 3.37,8; "4.22,2" for 4.22,3; "6.32,3" for 6.32,4); it is also tagged language Latin.
Matches the leaf throughout, footnotes "Plate XVIII, Fig 1" and "Iliad ι, ver. 381" included; the only change is the leaf's misprint "igures" silently corrected to "figures".

Stored text is EMPTY, but the leaf is a full page of clean print (Natural Law p.221, sections III-IV, "We must not therefore confound the words just, useful, and honest" plus side-notes), so readers get nothing.

english-print.page_kind: prose with chapter heading and side-notes
english-print.note: The first ~16 lines are accurate, but the text stops mid-word at "doe *w" (wither), losing the rest of §82, the whole CHAP. XXIII heading and argument, §1 and the start of §2 (~28 lines); it also opens with model chatter ("Note: The text in the image is in Early Modern English...") served as page text.

Faithful across the whole page ("extenuated with fasting", "Kingdome of fruitful Corinth", "Laertius mentions an Epistle"); spelling is modernised a little (long s, "Procleus"), the inline “ quotation is turned into a blockquote, and the signature G and catchword are kept.

english-print.page_kind: book opening: title, dramatis personae, prose
english-print.note: Exact: the persons table, the scene note, "Steph. 327", "festival of Bendis¹" and the footnote "The Thracian Artemis" all match.
Matches the leaf word for word through "no doubt on the part of the intelligent"; the only loss is the italic on "bones".

Faithful, with long s kept ("juſt quoted from Cæsar"), and the footnotes "Pro. M. Fonteio" and "Cohibere parietibus Deos... Tacitus de Mor. Germ." are correct; the leaf's "( 61 )" header is moved into page-num.
Both pages, 56 and 57, are transcribed completely and accurately ("Jano-Maòli rocks", "Duke's Nose", "3,000 feet", "18,000 feet"), with headers correct.
